features.name: Current Threat Detection
features.purpose: Real-time threat classification of the latest traffic window.
features.what_user_sees: Risk Gauge, current attack stage, severity level, classifier confidence percentage, and active threat evidence panel.
features.output: current_status, current_attack, current_risk, current_risk_level, confidence, evidence
features.post_processing: Confidence capped and mapped mathematically from the max of inferred attack probability and calculated risk.
features.dynamic_or_static: DYNAMIC - Updates automatically based on features extracted from the uploaded capture file.
features.real_data_verification: Tested using the CTU-13 Neris PCAP file; values update dynamically when run.
limitations: Does not call the ANTCM ML classifier directly for inference due to scikit-learn dependency version mismatches.

features.name: Future Attack Forecasting
features.purpose: Forecast future risk and stage progression for upcoming network states.
features.what_user_sees: Future risk headline, 60-min horizon KPI, forecasted risk area chart, and 4-step forward timeline simulation.
features.input_data: Last 5 network states as a sequence
features.output: predicted_risk, predicted_stage, confidence, forecast timeline steps
features.post_processing: Probabilities rounded and formatted into percentages.
features.graphical_representation: Risk Over Time Area Chart + simulation cards
features.dynamic_or_static: DYNAMIC - Changes according to the network state sequence calculated from input PCAP.
features.real_data_verification: LSTM model loads successfully on disk. If disabled, the deterministic mathematical trend fallback is invoked.
limitations: LSTM is trained on synthetic sequence vectors; real-world drift may occur.

features.name: Network Behaviour Graph
features.purpose: Build and visualize host communication topologies dynamically.
features.what_user_sees: 3D host network graph, host metrics (Hosts, Connections, Suspicious Hosts, Critical Hosts), and clicked node inspection panel.
data_displayed: Host counts and risk severity levels
Selected node in-degree, out-degree, bytes sent/received
features.preprocessing: Groupby src/dst IPs and count packet and byte volumes
features.post_processing: Decorated node size and edge width mappings.
features.real_data_verification: Verified end-to-end; node list matches exactly the unique IPs in the analyzed capture segment.
limitations: Limited to 3D representation; layout can get cluttered for large captures (>5000 records).

features.name: Threat Risk Scoring
features.purpose: Expose multi-component composite risk assessment metrics.
features.what_user_sees: Overall risk level (Low, Medium, High, Critical), current vs future risk comparison, score breakdown, risk trend list, and plain-English risk explanation.
features.output: overall_risk_score, risk_level, current_risk, future_risk, components, risk_trend, top_risk_drivers, explanation
features.post_processing: Risk values mapped into risk bands (LOW 0-30, MEDIUM 31-60, HIGH 61-80, CRITICAL 81-100).
features.real_data_verification: Formulas verified against backend codebase. Score updates dynamically when new PCAP is processed.
limitations: Scoring weights are hardcoded as static coefficients in the risk engine.
